cohort: Obese pregnant women (n=83,500) from the Consortium on Safe Labor database
finding: The study identified several independent predictors of VTE in obese pregnant women, including mode of delivery, body mass index, pregestational diabetes, chronic heart disease, preeclampsia, blood transfusion, prenatal history of thromboembolic disorder, and postpartum maternal length of stay.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was an independent predictor of VTE in obese pregnant women.
